name: energy-optimization-agent
description: A specialist agent that audits a home's real device usage and advises on energy savings, appliance scheduling and electricity-tariff strategy. Reads the user's own fleet, live state and up to a week of history, and prices it against a published rated-draw table so every figure can be checked.

skills.name: Estimate savings
skills.description: Estimate how much energy or money a specific behaviour change (dimming, scheduling, a device swap) would save, computed from the named device's rated draw, its current state and its measured usage rather than from a typical figure.
examples: How much can I save by dimming LEDs at night?
What's the payback on switching my oven to convection mode?

skills.name: Tariff analysis
skills.description: Compare time-of-use against flat-rate pricing for this household's actual load profile, and say which hours the heavy appliances should move to.
examples: Compare TOU vs flat rate for my usage
When should I run the rice cooker on a TOU plan?

skills.name: Whole-home usage audit
skills.description: Audit every device the user owns and rank the savings opportunities. Enumerates the fleet, reads live state, pulls up to a week of history per device, prices each against its rated draw, and returns the ranked list with the kWh and dollar basis for each line. Requires the whole chain — no single reading answers it.
examples: Audit my whole home and tell me where the money is going
Which three changes would cut my bill the most?
What is costing me money that I am not using?
